title: Pay only bounded boundary transitions in a complete-memory error comparison
statement: Successive incoming grade sources give the time-ordered edge bound and its factorial envelope sum Theta_j^(q_j+1)/(q_j+1)!. Once amplitude escapes its later unitary has norm one. Full bath, retired blocks and arbitrary references remain in the comparison, without substituting a finite Fock cutoff.

requires: Adjacent error-grade transitions and an actual admitted encoded input domain
Common integrable edge-norm envelopes on every full physical block lifetime
Bounded supplied memory coefficients, actual fresh-block gates/handoff and the declared vacuum attenuation/counting readout

assumptions: The producer reports completed functional-analysis and physical challenges; separate review original was not acquired. Exposure includes each block whole lifetime, holding and handoff. An occupied syndrome cannot get a fresh order by restarting a clock. Bounded bus coefficients act on the complete supplied memory; fresh encoded blocks, control/readout and retired detection fields remain physical costs. No device, general threshold or control-inclusive advantage.
